# Education.com

> > Education.com provides comprehensive, interactive learning resources aligned with Common Core standards for English Language Arts instruction across elementary grades.

Education.com offers a curated collection of grammar, spelling, and writing activities designed for K-12 students. The platform features interactive worksheets, exercises, and lesson plans that help educators and parents teach foundational language arts skills through engaging, award-winning educational materials.

## Key Topics

- Grammar & Mechanics
- English Language Arts
- Parts of Speech
- Nouns
- Spelling & Verbs
- Common Core Standards
- Interactive Worksheets
- Writing Activities
- Vocabulary & Word Meaning
- Elementary Grades (3-5)
- Educational Resources
- Singular & Plural Nouns
- 4th Grade Curriculum

## Grammar & Parts of Speech

- [Nouns Activities](https://www.education.com/activity/?q=Nouns): Nouns activities with worksheets, games, and lesson plans for grammar learning, including common and proper nouns, and singular/plural forms.

## Spelling & Vocabulary

- [Spelling Verbs Exercises](https://www.education.com/exercises/?q=spelling+verbs): Interactive spelling exercises for verbs with award-winning educational materials.

## Grade-Level Writing Activities

- [4th Grade Word Meaning Writing Activities](https://www.education.com/activity/fourth-grade/writing/?q=word-meaning): 4th grade writing activities focusing on word meaning and vocabulary skills aligned with grade-level standards.
